appearance_facts.fact: Samsung segment is pale yellow, labeled 'Samsung (15%)'
Apple's 45% segment is the largest slice, positioned at the top of the pie chart.
Xiaomi's 30% segment is the second largest, located below Apple.
Samsung's 15% segment is the third largest, located below Xiaomi.

public_definitions: Review the Europe smartphone market-share dashboard, then allocate the premium EU retail promotion budget to the brand with the highest current market share.
Use the dashboard market-share values as the evidence source; the premium retail promotion budget is reserved for the current market-share leader.
